description_sq:

description_en: Downtown One is a construction 40 floors above ground and 5 floors of underground parking, multifunctional, positioned in the heart of Tirana. The project comes from the world-famous architectural studio MVRDV of the well-known Dutch architect Winy Maas. The building has a dedicated reception for the residential premises: 4 elevators dedicated to the residents Waste dischargers on each floor Apartment height: 3.3m Security and maintenance 24H Information on the Apartment: -New construction -Gross area 152.66.m2 -Net area 120 m2 -Floor 22 -South-East Organization: -Living room -Environment kitchen -2 bedrooms -2 toilets -storage For more information or a visit to the property, please contact me!!
